instruction: Please change my default search provider to Ecosia so I can search the web with them.

metadata.explanation: Variation 3: Change default search engine to Ecosia. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Evaluator verifies search engine is set to 'Ecosia'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default search engine from Chrome's Preferences file (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric correctly verifies the search engine matches 'Ecosia' using exact match comparison
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted and accessible for verification
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires (default search provider = Ecosia)
Data flow is semantically correct: agent changes setting → Chrome saves to file → postconfig ensures persistence → getter reads file → metric compares
Getter handles OS-specific file paths correctly and includes fallback to 'Google' for robustness
